- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate prices after recent sharp spikes (e.g., >78.5) — adjust up by 1–2% if sentiment remains positive.
- Overshoot in early 30d forecast when sentiment is neutral or slightly negative — cap forecast at 1–2% below recent 18d high.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is >10% above 18d average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.05 after 3–5 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% per day until sentiment recovers.
- Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment spikes — ignore sentiment >0.20 for 30d forecast unless preceded by 3+ days of strong sentiment.
